articles.summary: – Completed quarter with $26.9 million in cash and restricted cash – Key U.S. patent was awarded, protecting exclusivity of stenoparib when used with the stenoparib-specific DRP® companion diagnostic into 2042 – AACR 2026 data linked higher stenoparib DRP® scores with enhanced overall survival in advanced ovarian cancer, further supporting DRP®-guided patient selection – […]
articles.title: Allarity Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Completion of the Phase 3-Ready Stenoparib Manufacturing Campaign - Allarity Therapeutics
